paragraphs.zh: 三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺
paragraphs.en: Synthesis process for the triketone herbicide tembotrione
paragraphs.notes: Invention title, printed centred in bold immediately below the header rule. Not a numbered [00NN] paragraph, so marker is null. 环磺草酮 is the Chinese common name; the identification with tembotrione is confirmed on this page by [0002], which prints "(Tembotrione)" directly after it.
Bold section heading, not a numbered paragraph. Precedes [0001].

paragraphs.zh: 本发明属于农药原药的制备领域，具体涉及一种三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺。
paragraphs.en: The present invention belongs to the field of the preparation of pesticide technical materials (active ingredients), and specifically relates to a synthesis process for the triketone herbicide tembotrione.
paragraphs.notes: 原药 = technical-grade active ingredient (the un-formulated a.i.), not "raw drug".
Bold section heading, not a numbered paragraph. Precedes [0002]. The whole of [0002] and [0003] sits under this heading, and [0003] is therefore an account of the PRIOR ART, not of the invention.

paragraphs.zh: 除草剂环磺草酮(Tembotrione)，化学名称：2-(2-氯4-甲磺酰基-3-[(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基]苯甲酰基)环己烷-1,3-二酮。由拜耳公司2007年研制的三酮类玉米田除草剂，其活性高于目前市场上的硝环磺酮和甲基磺草酮，对作物安全。对多种杂草有很强的杀灭作用，无残留活性，有较强的抗雨水冲刷能力，且除草谱广，能有效防除辣子草属、旋花属、婆婆纳属、猪殃殃等杂草。
paragraphs.en: The herbicide tembotrione (Tembotrione), chemical name: 2-(2-chloro 4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl)cyclohexane-1,3-dione. A triketone maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of 硝环磺酮 and 甲基磺草酮 currently on the market, and it is safe to the crop. It has a very strong killing action on many kinds of weeds, has no residual activity, has fairly strong resistance to being washed off by rain, and has a broad weed-control spectrum, being able to effectively control weeds such as Galinsoga (辣子草属), Convolvulus (旋花属), Veronica (婆婆纳属) and cleavers (猪殃殃).
paragraphs.notes: TWO THINGS READ AS PRINTED AND DELIBERATELY NOT CORRECTED. (1) The chemical name is printed "2-氯4-甲磺酰基" with NO hyphen between 氯 and 4; every other locant on the page carries its hyphen. Verified at 4x: 氯 is followed by inter-script whitespace and then "4-", with no dash glyph. The intended reading is almost certainly 2-氯-4-甲磺酰基 (2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl), but the hyphen is genuinely absent from the page and has not been supplied. (2) 硝环磺酮 is printed exactly as transcribed, verified character-by-character at 6x (硝 环 磺 酮). This is not a standard Chinese herbicide name; the two established names it sits between are 硝磺草酮 (mesotrione) and 环磺酮. Because 甲基磺草酮 in the same sentence is itself a common Chinese name for mesotrione, reading 硝环磺酮 as mesotrione would make the sentence name the same compound twice. The identification is therefore left open and the characters are recorded as printed. 甲基磺草酮 is likewise left untranslated for the same reason. Parenthesis, bracket and locant-comma widths follow the page-level transcription convention in notes.

paragraphs.zh: 现有技术采用的合成路线有以下缺点：(1)采用甲硫醇钠气味比较大，废水中的硫醇难于处理，造成环境污染；(2)生产成本过高；(3)采用N-溴琥珀酸亚胺作溴化剂，该溴化剂昂贵。
paragraphs.en: The synthesis routes used in the prior art have the following drawbacks: (1) the use of sodium methanethiolate gives off a comparatively strong odour, and the mercaptan in the waste water is hard to treat, causing environmental pollution; (2) the production cost is too high; (3) N-bromosuccinimide is used as the brominating agent, and this brominating agent is expensive.
paragraphs.notes: THIS IS THE PRIOR-ART PARAGRAPH. It sits under 背景技术 and its subject is 现有技术 ("the existing/prior art"), so the three reagents it names - 甲硫醇钠 (sodium methanethiolate / sodium thiomethoxide), and N-溴琥珀酸亚胺 as brominating agent - belong to the PRIOR-ART route and must not be attributed to the invention. There is no drawn scheme anywhere on this page; the prior art is described in words only. N-溴琥珀酸亚胺 is printed exactly as transcribed, verified at 5x (溴 琥 珀 酸 亚 胺). It is the reagent NBS, whose standard Chinese names are N-溴代琥珀酰亚胺 / N-溴代丁二酰亚胺; the printed form uses 酸 where the standard form uses 酰 and omits 代. Read as printed, not corrected. Translated as N-bromosuccinimide because that is unambiguously the reagent meant, and this is flagged here rather than silently normalised.
Bold section heading, not a numbered paragraph. Precedes [0004]. Everything from [0004] onward is the INVENTION, in contrast to [0002]-[0003] above.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明所要解决的技术问题在于针对上述现有技术而提出一种三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，通过改进其工艺路线，缩短了工艺反应时间，革除了气味大的甲硫醇钠和剧毒氰基丙酮，提高了收率，三废少，实现了清洁环保生产。
paragraphs.en: The technical problem to be solved by the present invention is to propose, in view of the above prior art, a synthesis process for the triketone herbicide tembotrione which, by improving its process route, shortens the process reaction time, does away with the strongly-smelling sodium methanethiolate and the highly toxic cyanoacetone, raises the yield, produces less "three wastes", and achieves clean and environmentally friendly production.
paragraphs.notes: 氰基丙酮 verified at 6x (氰 基 丙 酮) = cyanoacetone (1-cyanopropan-2-one / acetonyl cyanide). This is the second prior-art reagent the invention claims to eliminate; note it is named ONLY here, not in [0003], so the prior-art reagent list is split across the two paragraphs. 三废 = the "three wastes" of Chinese industrial-environmental usage: waste gas, waste water and waste residue.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明解决上述技术问题所采用的技术方案是：三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，包括有以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: The technical solution adopted by the present invention to solve the above technical problem is: a synthesis process for the triketone herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: Opens the numbered step list [0006] onward. The wording is word-for-word identical to the opening of claim 1 on p02.
Step heading. 甲磺酰基 = methanesulfonyl (mesyl).

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯甲苯、催化剂无水三氯化铝和溶剂加入到反应瓶中，在0℃-15℃间滴加甲磺酰氯，滴加完毕，升至室温继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，将反应物倒入冰水中，用溶剂萃取，浓缩，得2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯；
paragraphs.en: 2-Chlorotoluene, the catalyst anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are charged into a reaction flask; methanesulfonyl chloride is added dropwise at 0℃-15℃ (see notes on the sign); when the dropwise addition is complete the temperature is raised to room temperature and the reaction is continued; the reaction is followed by LC until it is complete; the reaction mixture is poured into ice water, extracted with solvent and concentrated to give 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene;
paragraphs.notes: TEMPERATURE IS AMBIGUOUS AS PRINTED and has been translated literally rather than resolved. The page prints 0℃ -15℃ with whitespace before the dash, verified at 6x. Two readings are possible: the range 0℃ to 15℃, or 0℃ down to -15℃. The whitespace is not evidence either way - ℃ is a wide character and the typesetter inserts a gap after every wide character before a Latin/digit run, exactly as it does in 15-20℃ elsewhere. Recorded as 0℃-15℃ so the ambiguity survives. Independently, p02 (claim 1) prints the same phrase the same way, so this is not a scanning artefact of this page. 无水三氯化铝 = anhydrous AlCl3 (Friedel-Crafts catalyst). LC = liquid chromatography, printed in Latin capitals.

paragraphs.zh: 2)2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成
在反应容器中加入2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯，无水三氯化铝和溶剂，在15-20℃温度条件下，滴加乙酰氯，滴加完毕后，在室温继续反应1-5h，反应完毕，将反应物倒入冰水和盐酸的混合物中，分出有机层，水层用溶剂萃取，合并有机层，水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯；
paragraphs.en: 2-Chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are charged into a reaction vessel; acetyl chloride is added dropwise at a temperature of 15-20℃; after the dropwise addition is complete the reaction is continued at room temperature for 1-5 h; when the reaction is complete the reaction mixture is poured into a mixture of ice water and hydrochloric acid; the organic layer is separated off, the aqueous layer is extracted with solvent, the organic layers are combined, washed with water and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene;
paragraphs.notes: The list 2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯，无水三氯化铝和溶剂 uses a full-width comma where the parallel list in [0007] uses the enumeration mark 、. Both marks are clearly distinguishable in the scan, so the inconsistency is in the original and has been preserved. Friedel-Crafts acetylation with AcCl/AlCl3.

paragraphs.zh: 3)2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: RING NUMBERING CHANGES HERE relative to steps 1) and 2), as printed. The substrate is named with mesyl at C6 (2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯) and the product with mesyl at C4 (2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸). This is read off the page, not corrected; it is the expected consequence of the principal characteristic group changing from methyl (toluene numbering) to carboxylic acid (benzoic acid numbering) when the acetyl group is oxidised. The same shift appears in the claims on p03.

paragraphs.zh: 在装有搅拌器的反应容器中分别加入步骤2)得到的2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯和次氯酸钠水溶液，加热反应，用稀盐酸酸化，过滤，水洗，干燥得2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；
paragraphs.en: Into a reaction vessel fitted with a stirrer are charged separately the 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene obtained in step 2) and aqueous sodium hypochlorite solution; the mixture is heated to react, acidified with dilute hydrochloric acid, filtered, washed with water and dried to give 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;
paragraphs.notes: 次氯酸钠水溶液 = aqueous sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl). Aryl methyl ketone to aryl carboxylic acid: a haloform oxidation, though the page never uses that word - the mechanism is not stated on the page and is not asserted here.

paragraphs.zh: 4)2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
paragraphs.notes: 甲酯 = methyl ester; the name is the methyl ester of the [0010]/[0011] acid.

paragraphs.zh: 将步骤3)得到的2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸和甲醇加入带有回流冷凝管的反应瓶中，加入催化剂浓硫酸或对甲苯磺酸，回流反应1-10h，蒸除过量甲醇，得
paragraphs.en: The 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid obtained in step 3) and methanol are charged into a reaction flask fitted with a reflux condenser; the catalyst, concentrated sulfuric acid or p-toluenesulfonic acid, is added; the mixture is refluxed for 1-10 h; the excess methanol is distilled off to give
paragraphs.notes: INCOMPLETE - the sentence runs off the bottom of the page mid-clause after 得 and continues on p05 (说明书 2/6页). No terminal punctuation is printed. The continuation is not on this page and has not been supplied. 对甲苯磺酸 = p-toluenesulfonic acid (TsOH); Fischer esterification.

discrepancies.what: There is not a single drawing on this page - no structural formula, no reaction scheme, no table. Every molecule, including the target compound and all four intermediates, is given by Chinese chemical name in running prose only. No drawing-versus-prose cross-check is therefore possible for p04, and no structure has been drawn or inferred.
discrepancies.text_says: all species named in prose: 2-(2-氯4-甲磺酰基-3-[(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基]苯甲酰基)环己烷-1,3-二酮 (target, [0002]); 2-氯甲苯; 2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯; 2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯; 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸; 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯

discrepancies.what: The prior-art reagent list is split between two paragraphs, so reading either alone gives an incomplete picture of what the invention claims to eliminate. [0003] names sodium methanethiolate and NBS; the highly toxic cyanoacetone appears only in [0004].
discrepancies.text_says: [0003] prior-art drawbacks: 甲硫醇钠, N-溴琥珀酸亚胺. [0004] eliminated by the invention: 甲硫醇钠 and 剧毒氰基丙酮

discrepancies.what: The target compound's chemical name in [0002] is missing the hyphen between the chloro and the 4-methylsulfonyl locant, unlike every other locant on the page.
discrepancies.text_says: [0002] prints 2-(2-氯4-甲磺酰基-3-[...] , i.e. 2-氯4- with no dash, verified at 4x

discrepancies.what: [0002] names a comparator herbicide 硝环磺酮 that is not a standard Chinese herbicide name, alongside 甲基磺草酮 which is itself a common Chinese name for mesotrione. Characters verified individually at 6x; not corrected.
discrepancies.text_says: [0002]: 其活性高于目前市场上的硝环磺酮和甲基磺草酮

discrepancies.what: [0003] prints the brominating agent as N-溴琥珀酸亚胺, which is not the standard Chinese form of NBS (N-溴代琥珀酰亚胺 / N-溴代丁二酰亚胺): 酸 appears where the standard has 酰, and 代 is absent. Verified at 5x; recorded as printed.
discrepancies.text_says: [0003]: (3)采用N-溴琥珀酸亚胺作溴化剂，该溴化剂昂贵。

notes: Page 4 of 9 = 说明书 1/6页, the first page of the description. It carries the invention title, the headings 技术领域 / 背景技术 / 发明内容, and paragraphs [0001] through [0013], with [0013] breaking off mid-sentence at the foot of the page. THERE ARE NO DRAWINGS, SCHEMES OR TABLES ON THIS PAGE AT ALL, so drawings is an empty array; the prior art in the background section is described in words only and nothing on this page had to be classified as invention_route versus prior_art from a drawing. On the prose evidence the classification is nonetheless unambiguous: [0002] and [0003] sit under 背景技术 and [0003] explicitly says 现有技术采用的合成路线 ("the synthesis routes used in the existing art"), so its three drawbacks and the reagents 甲硫醇钠 and N-溴琥珀酸亚胺 are PRIOR ART; everything from the 发明内容 heading onward, i.e. [0004] and the numbered steps 1) to 4) in [0006]-[0013], is the INVENTION's own route. [0004] confirms the split by saying the invention 革除了 (does away with) the prior-art reagents. Every Chinese character on the page was checked at 2x and the chemically load-bearing ones again at 4x-6x; nothing was illegible and the illegible array is empty. ONE TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTION, flagged because it is a judgement call and not a direct reading, and adopted to match the sibling reads of p02 and p03: this scan compresses all punctuation to roughly 0.6 em regardless of whether the underlying character is full-width or half-width. Measured against a 31.7 px CJK advance at this scan resolution, a prose comma advances ~19 px and a locant comma ~17 px, which is too close to call. Sentence-level and list-level punctuation (，。：；、) has therefore been written full-width, and parentheses, square brackets and commas inside numeric locants (1,3-; 2,2,2-; (1)(2)(3); 步骤2)) half-width. The typesetter also inserts a space at every CJK-to-Latin/digit boundary (printed 2- 氯 -6- 甲磺酰基甲苯); these inter-script spaces are typesetting, not content, and have been dropped, again matching p02 and p03. CROSS-VALIDATION: [0006]-[0013] are word-for-word the same process text as claim 1 on p02, and the independent p02 read agrees with this one character for character, including the ambiguous 0℃-15℃.
